title: update_passage
description: Mutate text/tags/position/size on an existing passage. Does NOT rename — use rename_passage for that so link integrity is enforced.

image_placeholders_reconciled.description: Count of ImagePlaceholder records removed because their emitted HTML is no longer present in text.
